parameters.name: localOnly
parameters.description: MPI data-parallel: expose this rank's tiles packed without gathering onto rank 0. Tiles are laid out in one horizontal row, with image channel dimensions (localTileCount * 32) by 32. Map channel.tileInfo for matching dimensions and ANARI_INT32_VEC4 entries containing each tile's full-frame origin x/y and valid edge-clipped width/height.
